podcast.title: Archive for 90s Memphis-Inspired Music
podcast.body: In the 2010s, SoundCloud became a crucial local archive for beats and loops inspired by the 90s Memphis scene, playing a key role in the genre's revival and the birth of phonk. "SoundCloud que se convirtió en un archivo local, Parabits y Loops inspirados en la escena de 2090 era."

podcast.title: Phonk Distribution Platform
podcast.body: SoundCloud is one of the platforms where phonk has mutated into thousands of variants, becoming a significant distribution channel for the genre's evolution. "En planta formas como SoundCloud y, sobre todo, TikTok, el generó a mutar 2.000 variantes."

podcast.title: Platform for Emerging Artists (2010s)
podcast.body: SoundCloud served as a platform for emerging artists, such as teenage indie musician Lorde, who began releasing songs on the service in 2012. "Then there was Lord, originally a teenage indie musician of New Zealand who began dropping songs on SoundCloud in 2012."
